name: Session expired
summary: A sign-in-again card that says why the session ended and shows that the person's unsaved work is kept on this device.
use: when a session times out while someone is working, before they lose what they typed
a11y: The title and reason sit in an alert, read as soon as the card appears. Move focus to Sign in again when you show it: the part never moves focus on its own, so a page that only displays it isn't hijacked. The saved draft is described in text, not only by an icon.
notes: Keep the draft in the browser before the session ends, and move focus to Sign in again when you show the card.

use_when: an idle or security timeout signs the person out mid-task
a token refresh fails while there is unsaved input
avoid_when: the person has no work in progress: send them to the sign-in page
they lack permission rather than a session: use page-no-access

parts.name: title
parts.what: the heading: what happened, in plain words, as in “Your session ended”

parts.name: message
parts.what: one or two sentences: what it means and what to do next, as in “For your security, we signed you out after 30 mi”

parts.name: draft
parts.what: the work that was kept, as in “Draft: Q4 vendor review”

parts.name: saved
parts.what: where and when the work was kept, as in “Kept on this device · saved 2 minutes ago”

empty.how: Not applicable: this state screen shows no list of records.

loading.how: Not applicable: this page stands in for content; it isn't loaded data itself.

error.how: The part is itself an error or system state, written in plain words with a next step.

disabled.how: No control here is ever disabled; each one always does something.

overflow.how: A long draft name ends in an ellipsis on one line.

long_text.how: Titles balance and body text wraps at word boundaries inside a capped measure.

keyboard: Sign in again is the first focusable control
Tab then reaches Use another account
